chunks.en: I'd like some help with my resume.
chunks.zh: 我想請你幫我看一下履歷。
accept: I would like some help with my resume.
chunks.note: 請人幫忙時說。I'd like = I would like，比 I want 客氣；help with 後面接要幫的事。

distractors.text: I'd like some helps with my resume.
I'd like some help for my resume.
I'd like some help with my resum.

chunks.en: Should I include my parents' names?
chunks.note: 問該不該做某事：Should I + 動詞原形？parents' 是爸媽兩個人的，撇號在 s 後面。

distractors.text: Should I to include my parents' names?
Should include I my parents' names?
Should I include my parents names?

chunks.en: Where do I put my education?
accept: Where should I put my education?
chunks.note: 問東西要放在哪裡。Where do I 後面接動詞原形，put 不加 s。

distractors.text: Where I put my education?
Where do I puts my education?
Where do I put my educations?

chunks.en: Do I list my high school too?
accept: Should I list my high school too?
chunks.note: list 在這裡是動詞「列上去、寫上」。too 放在句尾，意思是「也」。

distractors.text: Do I list too my high school?
Do I lists my high school too?
Do I list my high school to?

chunks.en: I've never written one in English.
chunks.zh: 我從來沒用英文寫過履歷。
accept: I have never written one in English.
chunks.note: 現在完成式 have + 過去分詞，說到現在為止的經驗；never 放在 have 後面，write 要用 written。

distractors.text: I've never wrote one in English.
I've written never one in English.
I've never written one in english.

chunks.en: I've had several jobs in Taiwan.
chunks.zh: 我在台灣做過好幾份工作。
accept: I have had several jobs in Taiwan.
chunks.note: I've had 也是現在完成式：到現在做過好幾份。have 的過去分詞是 had，所以會連著出現 have had。

distractors.text: I've have several jobs in Taiwan.
I've had several job in Taiwan.
I've had several jobs at Taiwan.

chunks.en: Could I see an example first?
accept: Can I see an example first?
chunks.note: 想先看看別人怎麼寫時問。Could I + 動詞原形，比 Can I 客氣；first 放句尾是「先」。

distractors.text: Could I see a example first?
Could I seeing an example first?
Could I see an example frist?

chunks.note: pretty 在這裡是「蠻、相當」，不是漂亮。look + 形容詞 = 看起來…，主詞是 this one，所以 looks 加 s。

distractors.text: This one look pretty clear.
This one looks pretty clearly.
This one looks clear pretty.

chunks.note: grew up 是 grow up（長大）的過去式，後面接 speaking 這種 -ing，說從小一直在做的事。

distractors.text: I grew up speak Chinese.
I growed up speaking Chinese.
I grew up speaking chinese.

chunks.en: Is Chinese a useful skill for this job?
chunks.zh: 中文對這份工作有幫助嗎？
chunks.note: 問某樣能力對工作有沒有用。Is 開頭問「是不是」；useful 開頭是 you 的音，前面用 a 不用 an。

distractors.text: Is Chinese an useful skill for this job?
Is Chinese a useful skills for this job?
Does Chinese a useful skill for this job?

chunks.en: I've just finished my first draft.
accept: I have just finished my first draft.
I just finished my first draft.
chunks.note: 現在完成式 + just：事情剛剛做完。just 放在 have 和過去分詞中間。

distractors.text: I've just finish my first draft.
I've finished just my first draft.
I've just finished my frist draft.

accept: I have not sent it yet.
chunks.note: 還沒做的事：haven't + 過去分詞，yet 放句尾＝「還沒」。send 的過去分詞是 sent。

distractors.text: I haven't send it yet.
I haven't sent yet it.
I haven't sent it already.

chunks.zh: 不好意思，推薦人是什麼？
chunks.note: 聽到不懂的字，先說 Sorry 再這樣問。what's = what is，reference 前面要有 a。

distractors.text: Sorry, what's reference?
Sorry, what a reference?
Sorry, what's a refrence?

chunks.en: I'm going to send it to Harbor Trading today.
chunks.zh: 我今天就要寄給 Harbor Trading。
chunks.note: 說已經決定好的計畫：be going to + 動詞原形。

distractors.text: I'm going to sending it to Harbor Trading today.
I'm going send it to Harbor Trading today.
I going to send it to Harbor Trading today.

words.zh: 大學（口語通稱，也指學院）

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi again! Welcome to the resume workshop.
scene.zh: 又見面了！歡迎來履歷工作坊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd like some help with my resume.
scene.zh: 我想請你幫我看一下履歷。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Let's start with your details at the top.
scene.zh: 沒問題。我們先從最上面的個人資料開始。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I include my parents' names?
scene.zh: 要寫我爸媽的名字嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No, not here. Don't add your mother, father or children.
scene.zh: 不用，這裡不寫。爸爸、媽媽、小孩都不要加上去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Just your name, phone number and email address.
scene.zh: 只要寫你的名字、電話和 email 就好。

fills.note: do I 後面接動詞原形，所以用 put。
從學校畢業是 graduate from。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, your details look good. Now, education.
scene.zh: 好，個人資料沒問題。接下來是學歷。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Where do I put my education?
scene.zh: 學歷要寫在哪裡？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right under your details, with the dates.
scene.zh: 就在個人資料下面，日期也要寫。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I list my high school too?
scene.zh: 高中也要寫進去嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not if you continued on to college.
scene.zh: 如果你有繼續念大學，就不用。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Just add your university, your degree and when you graduated.
scene.zh: 寫上你的大學、學位和畢業時間就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Have you ever written a resume in English?
scene.zh: 你有用英文寫過履歷嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've never written one in English.
scene.zh: 我從來沒用英文寫過履歷。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's okay. Let's do your work history next.
scene.zh: 沒關係。接下來寫你的工作經歷。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've had several jobs in Taiwan.
scene.zh: 我在台灣做過好幾份工作。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. List the one you had most recently first.
scene.zh: 很好。最近做的那份寫在最前面。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Under each job, add a short description of what you did.
scene.zh: 每份工作下面，加幾句說明你做了什麼。

lines: Work Experience: Office assistant, Sunny Foods, 2019-2023
Main work: answering the phone, writing emails, taking orders
Other: good with computers, speaks Chinese and English

questions.en: What was Amy's main work at Sunny Foods?
questions.zh: Amy 在 Sunny Foods 主要做什麼？

questions.en: When did Amy graduate from college?
questions.zh: Amy 什麼時候大學畢業？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now let's describe your main work at each job.
scene.zh: 現在來描述你每份工作主要做什麼。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could I see an example first?
scene.zh: 可以先看一份範例嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Here's one from a past student.
scene.zh: 好啊。這是以前一個學員寫的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This one looks pretty clear.
scene.zh: 這份看起來蠻清楚的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right. Short sentences, and only relevant background.
scene.zh: 對。句子短短的，只寫跟工作有關的背景。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And everything in the document has to be true.
scene.zh: 還有，上面寫的每一件事都必須是真的。

lines.en: So, Ken, what languages do you speak?
lines.zh: 那 Ken，你會說哪些語言？

lines.en: English and Chinese. My parents are from Taiwan.
lines.zh: 英文和中文，我爸媽是台灣人。

lines.en: Nice. Anything special, like a certificate?
lines.zh: 不錯。有什麼特別的嗎？像是證照？

lines.en: Just one, for typing. Where should I put my languages?
lines.zh: 只有一張打字的。語言要寫在哪裡？

lines.en: Under Skills. The company works with Taiwan, so Chinese really helps.
lines.zh: 寫在「技能」那欄。那家公司跟台灣有往來，所以會中文很加分。

questions.en: Where should Ken put his languages?
questions.zh: Ken 應該把語言寫在哪裡？

questions.en: Why is Chinese useful for the job?
questions.zh: 為什麼中文對這份工作有用？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, skills. What languages do you speak?
scene.zh: 好，接下來是技能。你會說哪些語言？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I grew up speaking Chinese.
scene.zh: 我從小就說中文。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice. So with English, that's two languages.
scene.zh: 很好。再加上英文，就是兩種語言了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is Chinese a useful skill for this job?
scene.zh: 中文對這份工作有幫助嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes! They work with a lot of foreign companies.
scene.zh: 有！他們跟很多外國公司有往來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mention it, and explain that you can type in Chinese too.
scene.zh: 一定要寫，也要說明你會打中文。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Sorry I'm late. How's the resume going?
scene.zh: 嗨！抱歉我遲到了。履歷寫得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've just finished my first draft.
scene.zh: 我剛寫完第一版草稿。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Already? Great. Have you sent it yet?
scene.zh: 已經寫好了？太好了。寄出去了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I haven't sent it yet.
scene.zh: 我還沒寄出去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Let me review it. Wait, there's a mistake here.
scene.zh: 那就好，我幫你看一下。等等，這裡有個錯。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I can stay while you rewrite this sentence.
scene.zh: 你重寫這句的時候，我可以留下來陪你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your resume is almost complete. Just add two references.
scene.zh: 你的履歷快完成了。再加上兩位推薦人就好。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, what's a reference?
scene.zh: 不好意思，推薦人是什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Someone from a previous job who knows your work.
scene.zh: 之前工作認識的人，而且了解你的工作表現。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then attach it and a cover letter as separate documents.
scene.zh: 然後把履歷和求職信分成兩個檔案附上去。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm going to send it to Harbor Trading today.
scene.zh: 我今天就要寄給 Harbor Trading。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great! Don't forget your signature at the end.
scene.zh: 太好了！最後別忘了加上你的署名。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi there! Come on in. How can I help?
scene.zh: 嗨！請進。有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd like some help with my resume.
scene.zh: 我想請你幫我看一下履歷。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course. Have you ever written one before?
scene.zh: 當然好。你以前寫過履歷嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've never written one in English.
scene.zh: 我從來沒用英文寫過履歷。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No problem. A lot of people here haven't.
scene.zh: 沒問題，這裡很多人都沒寫過。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could I see an example first?
scene.zh: 可以先看一份範例嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure, here you go. Start with your details and education.
scene.zh: 好，給你。先從個人資料和學歷開始寫。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I list my high school too?
scene.zh: 高中也要寫進去嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No, just college. Do you speak any other languages?
scene.zh: 不用，寫大學就好。你還會說別的語言嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I grew up speaking Chinese.
scene.zh: 我從小就說中文。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great, add that. That's a useful skill here.
scene.zh: 很好，寫上去。這在這裡是很有用的技能。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Sorry I'm late. How's it going?
scene.zh: 嗨！抱歉我來晚了。寫得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've just finished my first draft.
scene.zh: 我剛寫完第一版草稿。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice! Let me review it for mistakes.
scene.zh: 不錯喔！我幫你看看有沒有錯。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It looks good. Just add a reference at the end.
scene.zh: 看起來不錯。最後再加一位推薦人就好。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, what's a reference?
scene.zh: 不好意思，推薦人是什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Someone from a previous job. Then you're all ready!
scene.zh: 之前工作認識的人。這樣就全部準備好了！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm going to send it to Harbor Trading today.
scene.zh: 我今天就要寄給 Harbor Trading。
